verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a way to unit test reactive state or logic, such as running runes in a test runner or testing outside a rendered component. The evidence that .svelte.js/.svelte.ts files hold reusable reactive logic (svelte-docs-12) is about code organization rather than testing, so it earns no credit here. The only on-topic item is a community comment calling unit testing a weak point with unclear docs (svelte-comm-11), which reinforces the lack of evidence.
